R.retrieval_profile: frozen (the measured one; --profile frozen is the default)

query_expansion.done_by: the answering model itself (the same server model id as the answer; frozen.json expansion.written_by); one extra call per question, before retrieval

prompt_format.source: kafka_sre_rag/prompts.py constants SYSTEM_PROMPT, INSTRUCTION, EXPAND_SYSTEM, checked against kafka_sre_rag/frozen.json prompts_sha256 by `python -m kafka_sre_rag verify` (all match on 2026-11-26)
prompt_format.version_names: no version constant applies to the ask path: the prompt is the frozen one (golden hashes in tests/golden); PACK_PROMPT_VERSION pack/4 (scripts/generate_qa.py) belongs to generation packs, not to ask; KB_ENTRY_PROMPT_VERSION kbe/5 and KB_CHECK_PROMPT_VERSION kbc/4 belong to the entries (off in this release test until Z4)

answer.how_thinking_is_off: request body chat_template_kwargs.enable_thinking=false, passed as --extra-body (applies to the expansion call and the answer call)

R.answer_profile: fast (default: --answer-profile not given; the thorough profile stays off)
R.other_options_off: --check, --revise, --mark-destructive, --mode other than default, --profile other than frozen, --max-tokens, --stream (not given)
R.server: the oMLX server, one request at a time; address from OMLX_URL (never recorded here)
R.runtime_files_note: prompts.py is pinned by a running job and may gain constants (kb entries); the frozen constants above are what count, and `kafka_sre_rag verify` must print match for all of them
R.name: R
R.description: release candidate v4.0.0: Gemma 4 31B 4-bit, frozen retrieval, default prompt, lookup cards on; fact entries on only if Z4 passes

model.folder: mlx-community/gemma-4-31b-it-4bit (relative to the oMLX model directory)
model.hf_revision_source: the folder's .cache/huggingface/download/*.metadata files (first line = commit hash; second line of a weight file's metadata = its sha256, equal to the sha256 computed here)
model.upstream_conversion: converted with mlx-vlm from google/gemma-4-31B-it at upstream revision 3548789868c5356dbf307c98e6f609007b82b3eb (README of the folder)
model.hash_check: every file hashed in two separate passes; the two lists are identical

server_side_model_settings.note: oMLX model_settings for this id; a request's temperature 0 is sent by the runtime, so decoding is greedy; no other server-side switch is on (mtp, dflash, specprefill, turboquant all false)

R.thinking_switch_note: the Gemma 4 chat template turns thinking on only when enable_thinking is defined and true (an absent key already means off); the explicit false is sent anyway, as in Z3, so the request is the same on both models

lookup_cards.z3_switch: scripts/m7_ka2.sh arm L = eval2.py answer ... --answer-profile thorough --no-thinking --no-verify --lookup-cards, extra-body enable_thinking=false, default prompt, temperature 0, 2,048 tokens; Z3 result gemma31 PASS (runs/m7/M7_KA2.md)
lookup_cards.place: after the excerpts, before the question
lookup_cards.terms: the names in the question plus the search terms of the live expansion (ask --lookup-cards); Z3 used the question's names only (replayed packs, W20)

R.ask_command: OMLX_URL=<server url> .venv/bin/python -m kafka_sre_rag ask --backend openai --model gemma-4-31b-it-4bit --extra-body '{"chat_template_kwargs": {"enable_thinking": false}}' --lookup-cards --json "<question>"
